effects: Signer sends exactly `assets` LBTC (0xecAc…11c1) to the vault via transferFrom, using the signer's LBTC allowance to the vault.
`receiver` gets vault shares (gtLBTCc). The number is floor(assets × totalSupply / totalAssets) after fees accrue, and calldata sets no minimum.
The vault supplies the LBTC to Morpho Blue markets in its supply queue. The signer's position is the shares.
formats.shown: Intent 'Deposit', the LBTC amount, the constant share ticker 'gtLBTCc' and the address that receives the shares.

findings.title: deposit: the intent is just 'Deposit', with no interpolatedIntent naming the amount, token or vault.
findings.evidence: descriptor.json display.formats deposit: "intent": "Deposit", no interpolatedIntent. Fields 'assets' (tokenAmount, LBTC) and 'receiver' are always visible.
findings.fix: Add interpolatedIntent "Deposit {assets} into Gauntlet LBTC Core for {receiver}" and set the intent to "Deposit LBTC".

findings.title: deposit: the number of shares received is set by the vault's exchange rate and is not in calldata.
findings.evidence: MetaMorpho.sol deposit: shares = _convertToSharesWithTotals(assets, totalSupply(), newTotalAssets, Math.Rounding.Floor). The function has no minShares parameter.
findings.fix: None possible in the descriptor. The 'Share ticker' field already names the share token.

findings.title: deposit: the amount field is labelled 'Deposit asset' although it shows an amount.
findings.evidence: descriptor.json deposit field path 'assets' label "Deposit asset" format tokenAmount

effects: Signer sends LBTC to the vault. The amount is ceil(shares × totalAssets / totalSupply), computed onchain, and calldata sets no maximum.
The vault supplies the LBTC to Morpho Blue markets.
formats.shown: Intent 'Mint', 'Deposit asset: LBTC' as a raw constant, the share amount in the vault token, and the address that receives the shares.

findings.title: mint: the LBTC amount pulled from the signer is computed onchain and never shown.
findings.evidence: MetaMorpho.sol mint: assets = _convertToAssetsWithTotals(shares, totalSupply(), newTotalAssets, Math.Rounding.Ceil). The function has no maxAssets parameter. The descriptor shows only 'Deposit asset' = constant "LBTC".
findings.fix: None possible in calldata. The spend is capped by the signer's LBTC allowance to the vault.

findings.title: mint: the intent is just 'Mint', which hides that LBTC is deposited. There is no interpolatedIntent.
findings.fix: Set the intent to "Deposit LBTC for shares" and add interpolatedIntent "Mint {shares} by depositing LBTC, to {receiver}".

formats.key: withdraw(uint256 assets, address receiver, address owner)
effects: `receiver` gets exactly `assets` LBTC from the vault.
Vault shares are burned from `owner`. The number is ceil(assets × totalSupply / totalAssets), computed onchain, and calldata sets no maximum.
If the caller is not `owner`, the caller's share allowance from `owner` is spent.
formats.shown: Intent 'Withdraw', the exact LBTC amount, the receiver and the owner.

findings.title: withdraw: the number of shares burned from the owner is computed onchain and not shown.
findings.evidence: MetaMorpho.sol withdraw: shares = _convertToSharesWithTotals(assets, totalSupply(), newTotalAssets, Math.Rounding.Ceil). The function has no maxShares parameter.

findings.title: withdraw: the intent is just 'Withdraw'. There is no interpolatedIntent naming the amount and receiver.

formats.key: redeem(uint256 shares, address receiver, address owner)
effects: Exactly `shares` vault shares are burned from `owner`. If the caller is not the owner, the caller's share allowance is spent.
`receiver` gets LBTC. The amount is floor(shares × totalAssets / totalSupply), computed onchain, and calldata sets no minimum.
formats.shown: Intent 'Redeem', the share amount in the vault token, the receiver and the owner.

findings.title: redeem: the LBTC amount received is computed onchain. Its token is not named anywhere on the screen.
findings.evidence: MetaMorpho.sol redeem: assets = _convertToAssetsWithTotals(shares, totalSupply(), newTotalAssets, Math.Rounding.Floor). The function has no minAssets parameter. The redeem fields do not include the underlyingTicker constant.
findings.fix: Add a constant field 'Receive asset' = $.metadata.constants.underlyingTicker, as mint does.

findings.title: redeem: the intent is just 'Redeem' and does not say that LBTC is received. There is no interpolatedIntent.
